list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT r FROM (SELECT 'latest' AS r, toInt64(9e18) AS k UNION ALL SELECT run, max(started_ms) FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start' GROUP BY run) ORDER BY k DESC
list.definition: SELECT r FROM (SELECT 'latest' AS r, toInt64(9e18) AS k UNION ALL SELECT run, max(started_ms) FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start' GROUP BY run) ORDER BY k DESC

panels.title: Simulated clock
panels.description: Wall-clock time of the replayed day (the run's start + simulated time).

targets.rawSql: SELECT formatDateTime(parseDateTimeBestEffortOrZero((SELECT any(JSONExtractString(config, 'start')) FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start' AND run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start'))) + toIntervalSecond(toInt32(max(t))), '%H:%i') AS clock FROM rider_events WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start')
SELECT countIf(type = 'requested') AS requests FROM rider_events WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start')
SELECT countIf(type = 'dropped_off') AS completed FROM rider_events WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start')

SELECT countIf(type = 'cancelled') / greatest(countIf(type = 'requested'), 1) AS cancel_rate FROM rider_events WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start')

panels.title: Waiting at the last batch
panels.description: Riders the matcher considered in its most recent batch.

targets.rawSql: SELECT riders FROM dispatch_batches WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start') ORDER BY batch_t DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT avgIf(quoted_eta_s, type = 'matched') AS quoted FROM rider_events WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start')

panels.title: Demand and outcomes per simulated minute (from Flink)
panels.description: Per-minute totals across all zones, computed by the Flink job; a minute appears once it closes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(ts) AS time, sum(requests) AS Requests, sum(matches) AS Matches, sum(cancels_no_match + cancels_eta) AS Cancellations FROM zone_features FINAL WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start') GROUP BY minute ORDER BY time

panels.title: Riders waiting vs drivers available, per batch

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, riders AS `Riders waiting`, drivers AS `Drivers available` FROM dispatch_batches WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start') ORDER BY ts

SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AS time, countIf(outcome = 'accepted') AS Accepted, countIf(outcome = 'declined') AS `Declined by driver`, countIf(outcome = 'quote_cancelled') AS `Rider refused ETA`, countIf(outcome = 'rejected') AS `Rejected as stale` FROM offer_responses WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Drivers by state (M10)
panels.description: From every driver status: each change of state moves one driver between the bands. Offline = reserve drivers not working (surge with driver response, M6b).

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, sum(d_idle) OVER w AS Free, sum(d_repo) OVER w AS Repositioning, sum(d_enroute) OVER w AS `To pickup`, sum(d_trip) OVER w AS `With passenger`, sum(d_off) OVER w AS Offline FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AS time, countIf(state = 'idle') - countIf(prev = 'idle') AS d_idle, countIf(state = 'repositioning') - countIf(prev = 'repositioning') AS d_repo, countIf(state = 'en_route') - countIf(prev = 'en_route') AS d_enroute, countIf(state = 'on_trip') - countIf(prev = 'on_trip') AS d_trip, countIf(state = 'offline') - countIf(prev = 'offline') AS d_off FROM (SELECT ts, state, lagInFrame(state, 1, '') OVER (PARTITION BY driver ORDER BY t, seq ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS prev FROM driver_status WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start')) GROUP BY time) WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Repositioning moves and late-driver cancels (per 10 s, M10)
panels.description: Moves: the matcher's plan every 5 simulated minutes; the simulator starts a move only if the driver is still idle. Late: the quote plus the rider's tolerance passed without a pickup.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, sum(started) AS `Moves started`, sum(rejected) AS `Moves rejected`, sum(late) AS `Riders gave up on a late driver` FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AS time, countIf(outcome = 'started') AS started, countIf(outcome = 'rejected') AS rejected, 0 AS late FROM reposition_moves WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start') AND type = 'move_response' GROUP BY time UNION ALL SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AS time, 0, 0, count() FROM rider_events WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start') AND type = 'cancelled' AND reason = 'late_driver' GROUP BY time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Matcher: solve time and tick-to-batch latency

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, solve_ms AS `Solve (ms)`, tick_lag_ms AS `Tick to solved (ms)` FROM dispatch_batches WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start') ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Zones under pressure, last 5 closed minutes
panels.description: Requests per free driver is the raw signal a surge-pricing policy (M6) would act on.

targets.rawSql: SELECT z.name AS Zone, sum(f.requests) AS Requests, sum(f.matches) AS Matches, sum(f.cancels_no_match + f.cancels_eta) AS Cancelled, argMax(f.idle_end, f.minute) AS `Free drivers`, round(sum(f.requests) / (argMax(f.idle_end, f.minute) + 1), 2) AS `Demand per free driver` FROM zone_features AS f FINAL LEFT JOIN zones AS z ON z.id = f.zone WHERE f.run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start') AND f.minute + 5 > (SELECT max(minute) FROM zone_features WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start')) GROUP BY z.name ORDER BY `Demand per free driver` DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Late events (Flink)
panels.description: Events that arrived after their minute had already closed; reported, not counted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS late FROM late_events WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start')
SELECT max(skipped) AS skipped FROM dispatch_batches WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start')

panels.title: Surge multiplier across zones (M6)
panels.description: Empty unless the run has surge pricing (python -m ridesync.live.sim --surge reactive|forecast).

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(ts) AS time, max(multiplier) AS Highest, sum(multiplier * demand) / greatest(sum(demand), 1e-9) AS `Demand-weighted mean` FROM zone_prices WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start') GROUP BY t ORDER BY time

panels.title: Expected vs actual app opens, next 15 min (M6)
panels.description: Expected: the pricing demand estimate (reactive or forecast) summed over zones, at each 5-minute price update. Actual: app opens in the 15 minutes that followed (from Flink). Assumes the default 300 s interval and 900 s horizon.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.time AS time, p.expected AS Expected, a.actual AS Actual FROM (SELECT toInt64(t) AS pt, max(ts) AS time, sum(demand) AS expected FROM zone_prices WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start') GROUP BY pt) AS p LEFT JOIN (SELECT intDiv(toInt64(t), 300) * 300 - arrayJoin([0, 300, 600]) AS pt, sum(quotes) AS actual FROM zone_features FINAL WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start') GROUP BY pt) AS a ON a.pt = p.pt ORDER BY time

panels.title: Surging zones at the latest price update (M6)

targets.rawSql: SELECT z.name AS Zone, p.multiplier AS Multiplier, round(p.demand, 1) AS `Expected opens`, p.supply AS `Free drivers`, p.source AS Source FROM zone_prices AS p LEFT JOIN zones AS z ON z.id = p.zone WHERE p.run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start') AND p.t = (SELECT max(t) FROM zone_prices WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start')) AND p.multiplier > 1 ORDER BY p.multiplier DESC, p.demand DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Riders who declined the price
panels.description: Price refusals per app open (a retry that is refused again counts twice), from Flink zone features.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(declines) / greatest(sum(quotes), 1) AS declined FROM zone_features FINAL WHERE run = (SELECT if('${run}' = 'latest', argMax(run, started_ms), '${run}') FROM run_markers WHERE kind = 'run_start')

SELECT rider_id AS "Rider", status AS "Status", driver_id AS "Driver", round((quoted_eta_s / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Quoted pickup (min)", round(((coalesce(matched_s, finished_s) - requested_s) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Min to match or cancel", cancel_reason AS "Cancel reason", updated_at AS "Updated" FROM trips WHERE run_id = CASE WHEN '${run}' = 'latest' THEN (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY started_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) ELSE '${run}' END ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT status AS "Status", count(*) AS "Trips" FROM trips WHERE run_id = CASE WHEN '${run}' = 'latest' THEN (SELECT run_id FROM runs ORDER BY started_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) ELSE '${run}' END GROUP BY status ORDER BY trip_rank(status), status
